decisions.reason: F1 overstated the endpoint Statement: completeness, distinctness and absolute simplicity are not supplied there. None is needed for this lemma: steps 1.1-3.1 prove inverse selected moves, restrictedness and finite reachability, and step 4.1 uses only the supplied simple induction-head identity to identify every allowed recursion with D(lambda). Removed the unused classification assertions while preserving the Statement, dependencies, all-field finite-e scope and declared Choice for B(Lambda0).

F3 omitted the chosen P-grading, type-one, finite label-weight and finite-union-of-upper-cones hypotheses of its splitting supplier. This is nonfatal for the witness: the integrable full Fock module has support Lambda0-Q+, independent simple roots make a fixed weight fix partition size and hence a finite-dimensional space, and its Lambda0 space is the vacuum line. Restored the exact F3 conditions and verified them in step 2.1, including the residue-space embedding from the lattice direct sum. Also cited the actual full-crystal supplier directly for F2. Residue independence excludes both |1111> and its congruent ambient lower lift; the linear J then excludes both symmetric counterparts. The original claim is unchanged.
